result.text: I can know fast that I want somebody. I can't know fast that I want to raise kids with her or grow old with her, because I haven't seen enough of her life yet. Those are different questions. So I try to notice when “I’m taking a chance on this person” has somehow become “this is the right person.” If nothing new happened between those two thoughts, I probably just got more attached.
